Capri shares earlier soared 10% after a Women's Wear Daily report that the owner of Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo has connected with investors who may be interested in acquiring the company. The process is said to be informal and one banker cautioned that it was not going to happen in the "near-term."

"Since Versace is now sold, we think finding a buyer to take on the MK biz could be challenging until ops stabilize, which is expected later this year, Jefferies analyst Blake Anderson, who has a hold rating on Capri
, wrote in a note on Tuesday.A sale of Jimmy Choo could yield >$500 million and could provide support for furth debt paydown and stock repurchases, Anderson added.
